answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using trust-graph spectral analysis. Agents compile peer interactions into a routing atlas, passing flow through an analytical prism to isolate sparse graph cuts. Trust links branch like resilient yarrow across honest peers, forcing attackers to expend verifiable interaction history and scarce social capital to earn authentic inbound edges per clone. However, compromising bridge nodes allows adversaries to channel trust to rogue identities.
